# PH's AIxArchviz FLUX2.k9b Series: IMAGE GENERATE

*A visually guided image generation workflow that turns depth, canny, sketches or other guidance images (or plain text) into photorealistic architectural imagery.*

Showcase: [Youtube Video Walkthrough](https://youtu.be/6aXJqRhjXo0)
___
## Support, feedback, suggestions and improvements highly appreciated ❤️
- comfycloud: [ComfyCloud](https://cloud.comfy.org/?via=ph01) (affiliate link, i may earn a commission)
- Web: [paulhansen.de](https://www.paulhansen.de)
- Instagram: [paulhansen.design](https://www.instagram.com/paulhansen.design/)
- LinkedIn: [Paul Hansen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ph3d)
- Discord: [PH's AIxArchviz Discord](https://discord.gg/3UW5ZaWpWq)
- Ko-Fi: [ko-fi/paulhansen](https://www.ko-fi.com/paulhansen)

___
## HOW TO USE THIS WORKFLOW
Make sure all models used in this workflow are available on your device (including correct folder placement). Load **1 OR 2 images for VISUAL GUIDANCE** (depth, canny, normals, sketches, lineart, scribble, ...) with up to 4 megapixel (2048×2048) resolution in the LOAD IMAGE (image 1/image 2) nodes as a starting point for your generations, set USE 2 INPUT IMAGES accordingly, then define your prompt e.g. "masterpiece architecture photography of a black wood tinyhouse entirely made of straight vertical black wood panels, (...)". TXT2IMG overrides the input images to let you create visual assets to be used e.g. as references for IMAGE EDIT.
___
### Custom Nodes:

None - this workflow only uses ComfyUI core nodes.

### Model Downloads for Local Inference

**diffusion_models**
- [flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9b-fp8/resolve/main/flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors) *(gated)*

   for higher quality on stronger hardware, use the **full** version of this model:

- [flux-2-klein-base-9b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B/resolve/main/flux-2-klein-base-9b.safetensors) *(gated)*

**text_encoders**
- [qwen_3_8b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-klein-9B/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b.safetensors)

**loras**
- [ph_f2k9b_localforestlab_v1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/paulhax/flux2-klein-9b-localforestlab/resolve/main/ph_f2k9b_localforestlab_v1.safetensors)
  *PH's custom FLUX.2 [klein] 9B LoRA for detailed trees & foliage (cc-by-nc 4.0)*

**vae**
- [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors)

**upscale_models**
- [RealESRGAN_x2.pth](https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/Real-ESRGAN/resolve/main/RealESRGAN_x2.pth)

*Models marked **gated** require you to log in and accept the license on the respective huggingface repository before downloading.*

Model Storage Location
```
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
     ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
     │    └── flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8.safetensors
     ├── 📂 text_encoders/
     │    └── qwen_3_8b.safetensors
     ├── 📂 loras/
     │    └── ph_f2k9b_localforestlab_v1.safetensors
     ├── 📂 vae/
     │    └── flux2-vae.safetensors
     └── 📂 upscale_models/
          └── RealESRGAN_x2.pth
```
